descriptions.text: If you heat emboss, you'll need a heat tool. It melts embossing powder and Heat & Stick Powder. Our Heat Tool is slim, sleek, quiet, and easy to hold. * 2 heat settings: low for drying ink, high for heat-setting powder * Has protective plastic tip to cover the hot metal end

images.description: A gray handheld heat tool with a dark metallic nozzle attachment, featuring a power cord and control button on top. The device includes a wire stand for safe placement during use. Stampin' Up branding is visible on the body of the tool.

A handheld electric stamping tool with a beige/tan colored body and chrome/silver accents, shown next to a heart-shaped golden yellow stamped impression on white cardstock. The device features a compact, ergonomic design with a button mechanism for stamping.
